digest.component_or_area: code_health metrics composition and analyzer integration seam
propositions: The lizard and jscpd adapters exist but have no registered code_health metric consumer, so only scc LOC payloads are observable.
Register structural/high-confidence complexity_summary and duplication_summary metrics backed by the lizard and jscpd adapters so adapter outputs are not dead code.
A per-command analysis_cache keyed by producer name plus repo/scan-root ensures each external analyzer runs at most once per metrics evaluation context.
Missing lizard, scc, or jscpd must yield an honest Unavailable reason naming the missing producer, not zeros or generic no-data.
Python and Go interface tests through metrics_cli must assert loc, complexity, and duplication values when tools are present and Unavailable when absent.
Unused language-dispatch code (ANALYZERS/resolve_analyzer/analyze_or_unavailable) should be removed in favor of direct adapter composition while retaining AnalyzerResult/Analyzer compatibility.
